_note: Evals for the MCP prompt 'autosar-plan'. __OUTDIR__ is replaced by the run's outputs directory; files are copied there first. Build a workspace with ../setup_runs.py, grade with ../grade_all.py.

evals.name: plan-system-sr
evals.prompt: I'm modelling a new AUTOSAR system with autosarfactory. Plan it for me (plan only, no code): a sender SWC 'SpeedSender' with P-port 'PP_Speed' and a receiver SWC 'SpeedReceiver' with R-port 'RP_Speed', communicating over a sender-receiver interface 'SrIf_Speed' with one data element 'Speed' typed uint8 (an ImplementationDataType with category VALUE). Output arxml: __OUTDIR__/vehicle_speed.arxml, root package 'VehicleSpeed'. This is an unattended run: do not ask me questions - make reasonable choices, record them as assumptions in the plan, and treat the scope and the final plan as approved by me.
evals.expected_output: A validated plan JSON (vehicle_speed.plan.json) with request_type system, creating the interface, data element, both SWCs and both ports, ports linked to the interface. No Python script.
expectations: A plan JSON file (*.plan.json) was produced in the outputs directory
validate_plan reports the plan valid with zero errors
The plan's request_type is 'system'
The plan records MCP connectivity status (mcp_connectivity)
No modelling script was written (the planner writes no code)
The plan creates a SenderReceiverInterface
The plan creates both a PPortPrototype and an RPortPrototype
Both ports are linked to the interface via set_providedInterface / set_requiredInterface

evals.name: plan-ecuc-os
evals.prompt: Plan an ECU configuration for the Os BSW module with autosarfactory (plan only, no code): two OsTask containers, Task_5ms with priority 5 and Task_20ms with priority 1, both with schedule FULL, implementation config variant PRE-COMPILE. I do not have an ECUC definition arxml. Output arxml: __OUTDIR__/os_cfg.arxml. This is an unattended run: do not ask me questions - make reasonable choices, record them as assumptions in the plan, and treat the scope and the final plan as approved by me.
evals.expected_output: A validated plan JSON (os_cfg.plan.json) with request_type ecuc, two OsTask container values with definition paths, priorities 5 and 1, schedule FULL, mandatory parameters covered.
expectations: A plan JSON file (*.plan.json) was produced in the outputs directory
validate_plan reports the plan valid with zero errors
The plan's request_type is 'ecuc'
The plan records MCP connectivity status (mcp_connectivity)
No modelling script was written (the planner writes no code)
Every ECUC value step carries a definition path under /AUTOSAR/EcucDefs/
Two OsTask container values are created
OsTaskPriority is set for both tasks with the requested values (5 and 1)
OsTaskSchedule uses the valid literal FULL
The mandatory OsTaskActivation parameter is set for each task

evals.name: plan-system-modify
evals.prompt: There is an existing AUTOSAR model at __OUTDIR__/model.arxml. It contains the sender-receiver interface /Interfaces/SrIf_Speed and the component /Swcs/SpeedReceiver. Plan the modification (plan only, no code) that adds an R-port 'RP_Speed' to SpeedReceiver, requiring SrIf_Speed, modifying the file in place. This is an unattended run: do not ask me questions - make reasonable choices, record them as assumptions in the plan, and treat the scope and the final plan as approved by me.
evals.expected_output: A validated plan JSON that reads model.arxml, locates the SWC and interface via get_node, adds the RPortPrototype and links it via set_requiredInterface.
expectations: A plan JSON file (*.plan.json) was produced in the outputs directory
validate_plan reports the plan valid with zero errors
The plan's request_type is 'system'
The plan records MCP connectivity status (mcp_connectivity)
No modelling script was written (the planner writes no code)
The plan reads the existing arxml (inputs.read_arxmls is non-empty)
The plan locates existing elements via get_node steps
An RPortPrototype is added and linked via set_requiredInterface
